candidates.definition_line: Output that flows from you, giving that feels like being
candidates.face_teaser: Ideas come easily and you give them away gladly. Creation, for you, is play before it is ever work. You make gatherings lighter and tables fuller without seeming to try. The one caution is drift. When everything flows, it’s easy to coast past your best.
candidates.family_clause: how you meet and remake the world

family_element.appetite: making, voice, and the urge to put something into the world
family_element.notAlone: not talent alone, but everything you shape and send outward

rulingRealm.phrase: Authentic Expression — output that happens before strategy
rulingRealm.desc: 食神吐秀 (the Food God expresses elegance): refined Qi moving outward without announcement. What flows out when the self is fully itself — not the assertion of 伤官, not the pressure of 七杀, just the natural emergence of what the DM generates when nothing is in the way.

gifts: Output arrives without effort or announcement — what they produce has the quality of something that simply happened rather than something that was made
Natural elegance that others experience as a gift rather than a performance; the giving doesn't register as giving from the inside
Able to sustain creative or expressive work over time in ways that more effortful people genuinely cannot
shadows: The cost of giving is invisible from the inside — depletion accumulates without warning and arrives fully formed
食神过旺则泄身太过: the over-extension into what feels natural depletes the foundation without signaling beforehand
Tends to undervalue what flows naturally — because it doesn't feel like work, it's often undersold or given away
__ore.hiddenDynamic: Beneath the natural generosity is often a specific unawareness that giving is happening at all — the output doesn't register as effort, which means neither does the depletion. By the time they feel genuinely exhausted, they've been running on reserves for longer than anyone knew.

outputs.desc: What you produce has the quality of something that simply happened rather than something that was made.
Others experience your output as a gift rather than a performance, because the giving never feels like giving from the inside.
You can sustain creative or expressive work over time in ways more effortful people genuinely cannot.

frictions.desc: The cost of giving is invisible from inside, so depletion accumulates without warning and arrives fully formed.
Pouring into what feels natural can drain your foundation without ever signaling beforehand.
Because it doesn't feel like work, what flows naturally from you is often undersold or given away.

career.mechanism: 食神 → natural output becomes the product, authentic production capacity
career.text: Excels in roles where what flows naturally IS the product — creative work, teaching, mentoring. Struggles in highly structured environments that require output to be performed rather than expressed.

relationships.mechanism: 食神 → naturally nourishing, structural generosity, reciprocity gap risk
relationships.text: Naturally nourishing to be near — people feel genuinely fed without being able to account for why. The pattern to watch: attracting those who receive well without giving back, because the giving never seems costly.

wealth.mechanism: 食神 → natural production capacity, undervaluation risk
wealth.text: Can generate real financial value through authentic creative output. The recurring risk: what flows naturally doesn't feel like it should cost money, so it gets given away or undersold.

health.mechanism: 食神 → invisible depletion, DM element bears the output load
health.text: 食神过旺 produces genuine physical depletion that arrives without warning because the cost was invisible at every intermediate stage. Restoration requires genuine rest, not just reduced output.

domains_round1_retired_2026-10-21.decade_lines.Health.helping.ahead: You ease into your body in these years, with better appetite and better sleep and more pleasure in ordinary days. You enjoy your health in this decade more than you have since childhood.
domains_round1_retired_2026-10-21.decade_lines.Health.heavy.lived: Comfort turned into excess in those years, with rich food, late nights and too little effort. Your energy dropped as the easy habits piled up, and what carried you back was a plain daily routine.
domains_round1_retired_2026-10-21.decade_lines.Health.heavy.ahead: Ease turns into slackness in these years, and good food and long evenings cost you energy. You stay well through a simple routine you enjoy, since pleasure is what keeps you to it.
domains_round1_retired_2026-10-21.decade_lines.Family.helping.lived: Home was warm in those years, full of meals and easy evenings with the people you lived with. You were the one who fed and comforted others, and your family loved you for it.
domains_round1_retired_2026-10-21.decade_lines.Family.helping.ahead: These ten years bring a softer household, with shared meals and unhurried weekends. You make the home a comfortable place, and relatives come to you because it feels good to be there.
domains_round1_retired_2026-10-21.decade_lines.Family.heavy.lived: During those years you gave your family comfort without limit, and some of them came to expect it. You spoiled the people closest to you, and you got your own ease back once others began to care for you in turn.
domains_round1_retired_2026-10-21.decade_lines.Family.heavy.ahead: Indulgence runs the household in these years, with treats, late meals and little order. The warmth survives while your family learns to look after itself, and you stop wearing yourself out to please them.
domains_round1_retired_2026-10-21.decade_lines.Career.helping.ahead: A craft or skill you enjoy starts to pay in these ten years. You earn through work that feels like pleasure, and clients return because what you make is good.
domains_round1_retired_2026-10-21.decade_lines.Career.heavy.lived: Comfort dulled your drive at work in those years, and easy jobs held you longer than they should have. You were well liked and under-stretched, and what carried you was the skill you kept practising for pleasure.
domains_round1_retired_2026-10-21.decade_lines.Career.heavy.ahead: Ambition softens in these years, and the easy option keeps winning at work. What you make still has value, and you move forward each time a deadline or a client gives you a reason to finish.
